_comment: ngsolve plasticity#6 (consistent vs continuum tangent). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, plane-strain J2 on unit_square maxh 0.3 VectorH1 order 2, traction 400: below yield the AssembleLinearization tangent and the hand-built continuum C_ep are bitwise identical (which validates the continuum implementation), in the plastic range they differ by ~35% in matrix norm. Newton with the consistent tangent converges in 9 residual evaluations with a quadratic tail; with the continuum tangent it is still short of tolerance after 120, at a constant ratio ~0.96. The qualitative claim holds; its stated 'factor of ~2-3 per iteration' does not -- the observed drop is about 4% per iteration.
